title: Signed projection lift for module Cech cochains
statement: With schemes X', T', f':X'→T', a module sheaf M [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], a finite family W, a nonnegative complex D and term identifications e, differential compatibility hd and local scalar compatibility hlinear as in [def-pc-ordered-cech-module-coordinates], there exists a cochain endomorphism P of L=(f'_*D)^ext whose full tuple coordinate at y on B equals the sum over permutations σ with y∘σ strictly increasing of sign(σ) times the restriction of the ordered coordinate q(s) at y∘σ to (product W_y)×f'^(-1)B. The restriction arrow is the canonical arrow from the full product intersection to the ordered intersection. All other summands are zero. Full tuple coordinates use e after extendXIso. This formula and the zero negative terms determine P uniquely. No homotopy and no kernel-vanishing hypothesis is asserted.

source.place: Tag 01FK, signed extension; Tag 01FM, projection cπ

proof.text: Define the natural-degree full tuple maps by the finite signed extension formula. Transport by the inverse of e. Naturality of e and restrictions makes the maps natural; hlinear makes every summand locally linear because both scalar maps land on the same intersection. Thus they assemble module-sheaf morphisms.

Identify the finite filtered sum with the existing signedCechExtension: injective tuples have one increasing sorting permutation and repeated tuples have none. Use signedCechExtension_differential for differential compatibility, then hd, pushforward and extension by zero. The construction satisfies the displayed coordinate formula, including empty families and degrees exceeding r.

proof_origin.note: Module-sheaf assembly of the explicit signed restrictions; a strictly separate step of the parent argument.

mathlib_searches.results: Only Dold-Kan summand and map lemmas were returned. They concern simplicial normalization, not the local module action or ordered Cech coordinates.
Generic Homotopy.compLeft composes an existing homotopy with a cochain map; it does not construct the signed projection or its locally linear homotopy.

Mathlib Concrete.to_product_injective_of_isLimit supplies coordinate injectivity. Repository AlternatingCechKernelNullHomotopic and both sorting identities work in AddCommGrpCat and do not assemble module-sheaf maps.

theorem orderedCech_module_projection_exists {X' T' : Scheme.{u}} (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    (M : X'.Modules) {r : ℕ} (W₀ : ULift.{u} (Fin r) → X'.Opens)
    (D : CochainComplex X'.Modules ℕ)
    (e : ∀ p : ℕ, (PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).obj
          (D.X p).val ≅
        ((cechComplexFunctor W₀).obj
          ((prod.functor (C := X'.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
            (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj
              M.presheafModuleCat)).X p)
    (hd : ∀ p : ℕ,
        (PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).map
            (D.d p (p + 1)).val ≫ (e (p + 1)).hom =
          (e p).hom ≫ ((cechComplexFunctor W₀).obj
            ((prod.functor (C := X'.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
              (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj
              M.presheafModuleCat)).d p (p + 1))
    (hlinear : ∀ (p : ℕ) (y : Fin (p + 1) → ULift.{u} (Fin r)) (B : X'.Opens),
        let c : Γ(D.X p, B) → Γ(M, (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ W₀ (y l)) ⨯ B) :=
          fun s ↦ ((e p).hom ≫ Pi.π (fun y : Fin (p + 1) → ULift.{u} (Fin r) ↦
            ((prod.functor (C := X'.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
              (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj
                M.presheafModuleCat).obj
                (op (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ W₀ (y l)))) y).app (op B) s
        ∀ (a : Γ(X', B)) (s : Γ(D.X p, B)),
          c (a • s) = X'.presheaf.map (prod.snd :
            (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ W₀ (y l)) ⨯ B ⟶ B).op a • c s)
    : ∃ P : ((((Modules.pushforward f').mapHomologicalComplex _).obj D).extend
      ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) ⟶
      ((((Modules.pushforward f').mapHomologicalComplex _).obj D).extend
      ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat),
      IsOrderedCechModuleProjection f' M W₀ D e P
